events.title: Miner strikes a rich seam
environment: asteroid with a workable seam (the miner's existing field: route target)
events.arrangement: Miner at cut range (<26 wu) off the rock face, inside a pocket the player can fly through
events.startConditions: Miner in WORK phase; seeded 'rich' roll on the field slot
events.visibleCue: The steady amber cut-beam suddenly doubles its spall - face-spall streaks fly at twice cadence

phases.name: cutting
phases.visible: Ordinary blind_cone work against the seam

phases.name: strike
phases.visible: Beam holds one spot; dense spall; the flank lamp arc widens to full deploy

phases.name: greed
phases.visible: Miner repositions twice along the same face, short hops, cutting each time - a hull working FAST reads different from a hull working steady

phases.name: haul_out
phases.visible: Loaded chevrons walk the stack; miner departs for home heavier than usual

events.completion: Miner leaves for its refinery with the loaded return read; the seam keeps a brighter scar decal-of-light (lamp) for a while

interruptions.outcome: Drops to breaking_the_pattern and flees per existing FLEE_RADIUS logic; seam stays rich

interruptions.trigger: Player parks inside the cut cone
interruptions.outcome: Existing GO_DARK reaction: the miner shutters and waits

playerInterference: Mine the same seam alongside (rich yield while the window lasts)
Follow the loaded miner home to find its refinery
Destroy the miner and take the spill
events.criminalOpportunity: A pirate or claim-jumper who reads the doubled spall knows the load is worth taking on the return leg
events.aftermath: Field slot keeps a +yield flag for a few cycles; two extra ore pickups if the miner dies loaded
events.fallback: If the rock resolves invalid (restore id-shift), the existing type-guard already falls back to the short fixed cut-beam and the event quietly ends at haul_out
events.notes: Pure re-parameterization of the existing miner cycle: cadence, hop waypoints, and a yield flag. No new choreography runner needed. PQ-045.causal-chain: LIVE on Ceres as link 1 of the authored six-event chain in traffic.js (_stepCeresCausalChain); actor ceres_seam_miner; seeds rich_seam+miner_loaded at strike so the hauler-call link can overlap under the concurrency cap of two. The extraction quantum stays the ordinary 8u parcel (owner-test pinned) — the chain does not multiply mining:npcExtraction; rich yield is ledger/choreography only until a Phase 3 presentation leaf consumes the stamps.

events.title: Full miner calls a hauler out
environment: shared transfer point 30 wu off the field edge
events.arrangement: Miner holds at the transfer point; hauler arrives from the nearest station lane; both inside one camera pocket
events.startConditions: Miner completes WORK loaded while a hauler with no manifest is in-sector
events.visibleCue: The miner does NOT turn for home - it holds at the field edge flashing the load strobe, nose out

phases.name: call
phases.visible: Miner station-keeps, heavy_burn strobe running while parked - a loaded hull holding still is itself the signal

phases.name: answer
phases.visible: Hauler breaks its ambient loiter, flies a visible straight leg to the field edge

phases.name: transfer
phases.visible: Both hulls parallel, 8 wu apart; miner runs spilling_the_count, hauler runs mouth_open; dust drifts between them

phases.name: split
phases.visible: Hauler leaves heavy toward the station; miner turns back to the seam empty

events.completion: Two ships leave in opposite directions, one visibly loaded, one visibly empty - readable as a handoff by anyone

interruptions.outcome: Miner waits out a 20 s timer then hauls home itself (existing return leg)
Both flee per existing logic; the load stays with the miner

playerInterference: Dock-adjacent players can undercut: destroy the hauler and the miner becomes a slow loaded target
Escort the transfer for ambient rep
Sit between them and both GO_DARK/BRIGHTEN react per role
events.criminalOpportunity: The transfer window is the softest moment - two parked hulls, one already unloading
events.aftermath: Hauler carries a real manifest (existing traffic.manifest) that a scan reads as ore
events.fallback: Either actor despawning reverts the other to its ordinary cycle at the next phase edge
events.notes: PQ-045.causal-chain: LIVE on Ceres as link 2; actors ceres_seam_miner + ceres_refinery_hauler; requires miner_loaded; stamp-only because the hauler is a retained real-target actor and cannot take a non-canonical redirect; seeds ore_handoff+hauler_ore_manifest as ledger flags only (no cargo movement, no cargo mint, no second cargo writer).
events.diagramMermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant M as Miner
  participant H as Hauler
  M->>M: WORK completes loaded
  M->>H: holds at field edge (heavy_burn strobe)
  H->>M: straight leg to transfer point
  M-->>H: spilling_the_count / mouth_open (20 s)
  H->>H: departs heavy to station
  M->>M: returns empty to seam

events.title: Tanker loads at an ice harvester

participants.note: runs on ship_mule + volatile manifest until the donor hull is promoted
ice-cutting variant of the ordinary cycle

environment: optional everyday_space_kit formed-vessel prop as the harvester's standpipe
events.arrangement: Miner works the ice face; tanker noses to a standpipe point 15 wu off, BOW toward it - couplings before cranes
events.startConditions: Ice field slot active with a miner in WORK; tanker role spawn available
events.visibleCue: A hull approaching a work site nose-first and slowing to a crawl - nothing else in the fleet leads with its bow

phases.name: approach
phases.visible: Tanker's long flat stacking approach, far wider than a fighter would fly

phases.name: couple
phases.visible: Bow-hold 6 wu off the standpipe; white flood lights the coupling point

phases.name: load
phases.visible: mouth_open cadence at the BOW; miner's spall keeps falling behind it - two trades working one rock

phases.name: depart_heavy
phases.visible: Tanker leaves with the mass strobe; wide turn, no hurry

events.completion: Tanker departs visibly heavy toward the station; miner keeps cutting

interruptions.outcome: Tanker breaks off FIRST (volatile doctrine), miner follows existing flee

playerInterference: Scan the departing tanker: volatile manifest
A hit on a loaded tanker produces the existing big secondary (wreck class fresh + burn VFX)
events.criminalOpportunity: Loaded volatiles are the highest value-per-shot target in the region - and everyone can read the strobe
events.aftermath: Station fuel market blips down on delivery (market news system exists)
events.fallback: No tanker available: miner's cycle continues alone; the standpipe prop just sits there (props never depend on actors)
events.notes: Needs a 'tanker' TRAFFIC_ROLES entry (hauler clone + manifest filter). Everything else is the hauler graph with the transfer at route index 1 instead of 0.

events.title: Salvage cutter strips a wreck, piece by piece
events.arrangement: Salvor holds 10-14 wu off the wreck's long axis, working side toward it
events.startConditions: Existing salvor job (yard<->hulk) reaches WORK at a wreck inside a traveled pocket
events.visibleCue: Three hooded amber umbrellas swing out and light the wreck's flank from above - salvage light is confession light

phases.name: survey_cut
phases.visible: picking_the_bones: cutter arc walks the seam line

phases.name: sever
phases.visible: Arc holds one point; a plate-sized fragment separates from the wreck (pickup spawn with the wreck's drift)

phases.name: wrangle
phases.visible: The LOAD act that makes a salvor a salvor: tether streak from the hip reel to the fragment, fragment reels in

phases.name: stack
phases.visible: Fragment vanishes into the cradle; drum stack lamp ticks the tally

events.completion: Repeats until the wreck's salvage budget empties (existing salvage.strip), then home_under_rock back to the yard

interruptions.outcome: Salvor's WATCH reaction; it yields the piece and cuts the next one - no combat over one plate
Fragment pickups remain; the wreck keeps its remaining budget

playerInterference: Steal cut fragments before the wrangle
Cut the far side yourself - two crews stripping one hulk reads instantly
Kill the salvor for its loaded cradle
events.criminalOpportunity: Fragments mid-wrangle are free-floating cargo with a witness who will not fight for them
events.aftermath: Wreck visually diminishes (existing wreck stages if present; else fragment count is the read); scrap pickups persist
events.fallback: Wreck despawns mid-cut: salvor plays one confused sweep (existing sweep lamp) and departs for the yard empty
events.notes: The salvor kernel cycle IS this event; the addition is spawning the severed fragment as a pickup between WORK and LOAD so the wrangle has a visible object. PQ-045.causal-chain: LIVE on Ceres as link 6; actor ceres_cathedral_salvor; requires aftermath_open from the tender-service callout so the grave can busy concurrently with miner service; seeds wreck_stripped+chain_complete.

events.title: Tug walks a drifting pod back to the stack

participants.note: runs on ship_mule until donor hull promoted

environment: free-floating cargo pod (pickup or everyday_space_kit berth pod as dressing)
station or platform with a marked stack point
events.arrangement: Pod adrift 40-80 wu off a station; tug approaches from the dock side; stack point in the pocket
events.startConditions: A pod exists off-stack (seeded, or aftermath of ev_pod_breaks_clamp)
events.visibleCue: A hull flying NOSE-FIRST at a dead object, decelerating to a crawl nobody else uses

phases.name: line_up
phases.visible: stacking flown for the POD - the tug's whole grammar is approaches on behalf of things

phases.name: kiss
phases.visible: Contact hold at 2 wu; cradle floods on; pod picks up the tug's exact drift

phases.name: walk
phases.visible: Pair moves as one at walking pace toward the stack, thruster ticks in count - seven, eight, nine, kiss

phases.name: set
phases.visible: Pod released at the stack point with matched velocity; tug backs off two lengths

events.completion: Pod sits in the stack; tug loiters at the apron or answers the next stray

interruptions.outcome: Tug aborts to apron loiter; debris pickups spawn
Tug station-keeps and WATCHes; yields the job

playerInterference: Steal the pod (it is real cargo)
Nudge the pod away and watch the tug patiently re-approach
Do the job first with your own tether
events.criminalOpportunity: A pod mid-walk is claimed property in the open - taking it in front of the tug is a witnessed theft
events.aftermath: Stack gains one pod (persists in sector state)
events.fallback: Tug despawns: pod stays adrift; the event re-arms for the next tug spawn
events.notes: The 'carry' is parented drift (pod copies tug velocity while linked) - no tow physics needed; the Massline tether system already proves object-carrying reads fine.

events.title: Repair tender services a miner at the seam
environment: asteroid field with an active miner
events.arrangement: Miner holds at its rock, cone dark; tender parks 6 wu abeam, working side inward
events.startConditions: Existing tender job (berth<->client) with the client resolved to a working miner whose wear timer fired
events.visibleCue: A miner's cut-beam dies mid-shift and the hull just SITS there - wrong for the trade, and the first responder is not a rescue ship

phases.name: callout
phases.visible: Tender's DEPART wake and a clean fast leg to the field

phases.name: hard_stand
phases.visible: Tender station-keeps abeam; four red corners come on; white bar deploys

phases.name: work
phases.visible: Weld stitch walks the miner's drill housing; miner stays dark and still - crew outside, do not push

phases.name: first_light
phases.visible: Miner's cone relights and takes a test cut; tender strikes the bar and departs

events.completion: Miner resumes its ordinary cycle; tender returns to berth - the whole story is one light dying and coming back

interruptions.trigger: Player noses inside the red corners
interruptions.outcome: Existing FLINCH reaction: corners brighten, weld star suppressed until you leave
Miner stays dark, then limps home at half speed - a visible consequence trail

playerInterference: Guard the repair
Kill the DARK miner (it cannot flee well mid-service)
Scan both: tender manifest reads parts
events.criminalOpportunity: Two parked hulls, one disabled, one crewed-outside: the softest double target the working world produces
events.aftermath: Miner's wear timer resets; if the repair failed, the miner's next three cycles run at reduced speed (visible limp)
events.fallback: Client miner despawns: tender flies the leg, sweeps once, returns (the existing no-client path)
events.notes: The tender cycle exists end-to-end; the addition is pausing the CLIENT's cycle during service. PQ-045.causal-chain: LIVE on Ceres as link 5; actors ceres_refinery_tender (factionPresence) + ceres_seam_miner; requires miner_wear; stamps ceresCausalServiceHold on the miner for the service window (presentation seam for the Phase 3 leaf — nothing currently reads it; job-owned hulls skip _stepMiner) and seeds aftermath_open early at callout so the cutter link can open under the concurrency cap.

events.title: Surveyor lays a probe line
environment: empty quarter of a pocket (no station within 200 wu)
3 probe objects (pickup-class, lane_furniture lane-pin as dressing)
events.arrangement: Three drop points 40 wu apart on a line crossing the pocket; surveyor flies them in order
events.startConditions: Existing surveyor 4-mark lattice job; probe-drop variant selected
events.visibleCue: The sideways-flying hull: a surveyor on the line crabs with its boom out, motion no other trade uses

phases.name: mark_run
phases.visible: reading_the_dark pulse rings while crabbing to the first drop point

phases.name: drop_1
phases.visible: A small lit object separates and stays - green pin lamp at rest

phases.name: drop_2
phases.visible: Same at point two; the line becomes visible as two green dots behind the mover

phases.name: drop_3_close
phases.visible: Third drop; surveyor holds at the far end and the three probes pulse ONCE in sequence - a wave down the line

events.completion: Probe line persists, pulsing lazily; surveyor departs to its next mark

interruptions.outcome: Surveyor returns and re-drops ONE replacement, once; twice and it abandons the line

playerInterference: Shoot probes (they are objects)
Steal a probe (pickup) and the survey line goes dark behind you
Follow the line - it points at the surveyor's find
events.criminalOpportunity: A probe line is a treasure map drawn in public: prospectors and pirates can both read where it is pointing
events.aftermath: Probes persist for the session as sector objects; a later rich-seam or anomaly event can seed AT the line's far end (composability hook)
events.fallback: Surveyor lost mid-line: placed probes stay; the wave-pulse close never fires (an unfinished line reads as exactly that)
events.notes: Drop = pickup spawn at self position; the sequence pulse is three timed lamp calls. The surveyor mark-lattice job already flies the geometry.

events.title: Prospector fires a claim stake

participants.note: prospector variant; donor hull prospector_skiff when promoted

environment: claim stake object (lane_furniture claim mark is the existing prop class)
events.arrangement: Small hull hunting across a field at reading pace, then one rock at close range
events.startConditions: Prospector-variant miner finishes a reading_the_dark hunt with a positive roll
events.visibleCue: A tiny hull that hunts like a surveyor but is dressed like a miner - and then it SHOOTS the rock

phases.name: hunt
phases.visible: Slow pass with green pulse ring - wrong signal for a mining hull, which is the tell it is prospecting

phases.name: stake
phases.visible: One projectile arc to the rock face; a lit claim mark appears where it hits (amber tick)

phases.name: circle
phases.visible: One tight possession orbit of the rock - animals and prospectors do this identically

phases.name: leave_or_cut
phases.visible: Either departs (registering the claim) or unfolds arms and starts cutting immediately

events.completion: Rock carries a persistent lit claim mark; a miner (this one or another) works THAT rock preferentially later

interruptions.outcome: Prospector holds the orbit between intruder and stake - the movement-only argument from the brief

playerInterference: Shoot the stake off the rock (claim erased - witnessed vandalism)
Mine the claimed rock and the owner reacts (PAINT + hold-off orbit)
Stake an adjacent rock with the existing claim beacon verb (U)
events.criminalOpportunity: Claim jumping is the founding crime of the belt - the stake tells everyone exactly what is worth stealing
events.aftermath: Claim mark persists on the rock; field slot records an owner id
events.fallback: Prospector dies after staking: the mark persists unowned - free real estate with a story attached
events.notes: The player already has a claim-beacon verb (U); this mirrors it for NPCs. Stake projectile = existing projectile VFX with a spawn-on-impact prop.
